title: Characterisations of constructible sheaves on a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma gives three equivalent characterisations of constructibility on a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme: constructibility itself, constructibility on the members of an open covering, and the existence of a partition into constructible locally closed subschemes on which the sheaf is finite locally constant (statement lines 11716-11730). The proof disposes of the implications (3) implies (1) and (1) implies (2) directly (proof lines 11732-11746) and then uses quasi-compactness of the constructible topology to extract a finite subcovering and refine the partitions, which gives (2) implies (3) (proof lines 11746-11756). The non-formal content is the refinement step, which is where the quasi-compact quasi-separated hypotheses are used. The claim is H2: two easy implications and one refinement argument.
